existing.description: The Posse Foundation awards a full-tuition scholarship to each Posse Scholar to attend one of its partner colleges or universities in the United States. Students cannot apply directly: they must be nominated by their high school or a community-based organisation in one of Posse's more than 20 recruitment cities, and they take part in Posse's Dynamic Assessment Process nomination programme. Posse describes the scholarship as neither a minority nor a need-based award, and states that it is open to students of all backgrounds. Beyond tuition, Posse runs a Pre-Collegiate Training programme before college, a Campus Program with staff and faculty mentors once enrolled, Posse Plus retreats, a Career Program and a Fellowship Program for alumni.
eligibility: Be nominated by your high school or a community-based organisation
Be in the first term of your senior year in high school
Demonstrate leadership within your high school, community or family
Apply on time, within your Posse city's nomination window
Be reachable through the Dynamic Assessment Process in your city

existing.selection_notes: Posse looks for leaders in their high schools and communities, students committed to their education who demonstrate academic potential, and students interested in teamwork and diversity, describing the ideal candidate as positive, motivated, talented and ambitious. The Posse Arts Program and Posse Veterans Program run separate nomination processes.
existing.best_fit: High school seniors in one of Posse's more than 20 recruitment cities who are nominated by their school or a community organisation and want a full-tuition scholarship to a Posse partner college.
existing.notes: Posse publishes 'full-tuition scholarship' and does not state an amount, because partner college tuition varies, so funding_amount is null. The pages read do not state that room, board, books, travel or a stipend are covered, so living and travel coverage are recorded as false rather than assumed.
existing.duration: Four years of undergraduate study at a Posse partner college or university
existing.application_period: Posse states that nominations are accepted in the spring and summer before senior year begins, and that nomination timelines and deadlines vary by Posse city or programme, so applicants must contact their local Posse office for the specific dates at the start of every calendar year.
